items.title: I love my NF so much.
items.text:
I love my NF so much.
This family has been so wonderful on every front and on my way to work yesterday my car broke down. I texted MB that I’d be late and instead of being upset (if this happened with my last family I would have had some consequence or just a major attitude from MB for something obviously out of my control) she called me to make sure I’m okay and told me to take my time and not to stress. I got my car towed and DB called me and said he would leave work and pick me up from the auto shop. They were really cool with the situation and handed me a check this morning for my Lyft rides to and from work while my car is getting worked on. 
I don’t have family in the area anymore and they have really become a huge support system. I just started a floral business and MB knew I had a wedding coming up I was doing the flowers for and took the week before off so I could work less hours and focus on that. 
I’ve had some amazing and some horrible experiences with NFs in the 5 years I’ve been doing this and I am so freaking grateful for them.

I can’t roll joints without a machine, but my ex rolled the best joints. We’ve been apart for a month and the other day I thought about not getting perfect joints anymore and got way too emotional. Fend for yourself my friend. We must do what we need to do.
